propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 both declare a 1,000,000 token context window, making sonnet-to-opus escalation a guaranteed no-op that incurs opus pricing without gaining capacity.

A context-limit retry loop that escalates from sonnet to opus will fail again at the identical window, creating a misleading diagnosis that opus could not fit the content when the truth is escalation never occurred.
The MODEL_LADDER entries are verified correct against the provider's live Models API; the defect is in consumption by escalation loops, not in the declared numbers.
New function escalation_rungs() filters models_at_or_above() to exclude rungs whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung, eliminating no-op escalations.
Both context-limit retry paths (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must consume escalation_rungs() instead of models_at_or_above() to avoid proposing rungs with no capacity increase.
Structural guards ensure MODEL_LADDER windows are non-decreasing and escalation_rungs() returns strictly increasing windows, preventing future no-op rungs regardless of table contents.
